recalled_knowledge.item: NEST GetQuanta NR fluctuation form: Ni ~ N(Nq/(1+Nex/Ni), sqrt(W0 Ni)), Var(Ne) = r(1-r)Ni + omega^2 Ni^2 with omega = W2 exp(-(elecFrac-W3)^2/(2 W4^2)), skew-normal shape W5; entries 6-10 ER; 11-12 extra NR terms
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: NEST v2.3-2.4 source code (NEST.cpp) and Szydagis et al. 2024 review
recalled_knowledge.reliability: likely (verified numerically: predicted sd(Ne) 17.52 vs MC 17.56; roles confirmed by the +-30 % scan)

recalled_knowledge.item: AmBe neutron spectrum shape (ISO 8529-1), mean ~4.2 MeV, tail to ~11 MeV
elastic n-Xe kinematics E_R,max = 4 m_n M/(m_n+M)^2 E_n = 0.0301 E_n (11 MeV -> 331 keV, matching LZ's 0-330 keV)
black-disk elastic angular pattern |2 J1(qR)/qR|^2 with R = 6.35 fm for Xe
recalled_knowledge.reliability: likely (used only as a lower bracket)

recalled_knowledge.item: recombination fluctuations in LXe are at least binomial (sub-binomial escape statistics not observed)
10-90 % central interval = +-1.2816 sigma; 2D-Gaussian 68 %/95 % containment radii 1.51/2.45 sigma
measured NR exciton-to-ion ratio Nex/Ni ~ 1 in LXe at these energies
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: NEST NR model, Lenardo et al. 2015

recalled_knowledge.item: NEST v2.4.x carries 13 free width parameters, the last two being additional NR terms
recalled_knowledge.reliability: uncertain (only their numerical effect is used)
